opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to postdoctoral researchers for additional support to help them achieve their full potential in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives or Fellows (members) supported by a Society Representative.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles within physiological sciences.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports development of novel educational resources or educational research projects in physiology.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or promote knowledge transfer and impact in physiology.
opportunities.summary: Supports pilot studies, technique development, and activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact within physiological research.
